examples.text: Ich habe vorgestern deinen Brief bekommen.
examples.en: I received your letter the day before yesterday.
I was here the day before yesterday.

examples.text: Warst du vorgestern in der Schule?
examples.en: Were you at school the day before yesterday?
What did you do the day before yesterday?

examples.text: Meine Freunde haben mich vorgestern besucht.
examples.en: My friends came to see me the day before yesterday.
